notes.title: There will not be a full version of Doge Simulator!
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends.
Doge Simulator demo was played by only 250 people. That's why the publisher canceled the development of the full version of the game...

If the audience will support us, maybe we will return to this project. But we don't believe in such miracles. Although hope dies last...

Thank you all for playing our game!
